injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.name: Kingston Flemings
injuries.detail: Flemings (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) won't play Wednesday in Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.detail: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

injuries.name: Peyton Watson
injuries.detail: Watson (back) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.detail: Merrill (elbow) is questionable to face the Grizzlies on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Ronald Holland II
injuries.detail: Holland is out for Tuesday's game against San Antonio due to a left knee contusion.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Tuesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Draymond Green
injuries.detail: Green is questionable for Wednesday's game in Dallas due to inflammation in his right elbow.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Al Horford
injuries.detail: Horford (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

injuries.name: Amen Thompson
injuries.detail: Thompson (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Clint Capela

injuries.name: Julian Phillips
injuries.detail: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Andrew Nembhard
injuries.detail: Nembhard (hip) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Tuesday that Haliburton (hamstring) is "getting there," but there's still no definitive timetable for his return to game action, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is probable to play Wednesday against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Austin Reaves
injuries.detail: Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Walker Kessler
injuries.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Walker (leg) to be available for Wednesday's game against the Jazz, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

injuries.name: Ty Jerome
injuries.detail: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game in Cleveland.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart (illness) won't play Wednesday against the Cavs.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Bam Adebayo

injuries.name: Nikola Jovic
injuries.detail: Jovic (illness) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Milwaukee, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Myron Gardner
injuries.detail: Gardner (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Bucks, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.

injuries.name: Ousmane Dieng
injuries.detail: Dieng will undergo a procedure to repair a fractured left finger Monday, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.detail: Murphy (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.detail: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.detail: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Detroit.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Nelson (ankle) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.detail: Brown is out for Wednesday's game against the Magic with a left hamstring strain.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow (back) is out for Wednesday's game against Orlando.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: De'Andre Hunter
injuries.detail: Hunter (hip) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Suns, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Precious Achiuwa
injuries.detail: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Suns, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) has progressed in his strength and conditioning program but will miss at least one more week, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
injuries.detail: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Felix Okpara
injuries.detail: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
